basis: Only candidate wording and fixed application contracts; no held-out outcomes consulted for these decisions or the follow-up design.

destination.reason: Unconditional exclusion of temporary event pages from canonical ownership.

relation.reason: Assumes a missing typed link and states none only applies when no relationship is evidenced, conflicting with the existing-link case.

duplicate.reason: Page-subject identity wording requires a check where distinct page subjects share a repeated claim about a third entity.

residue.reason: A source citation is conflated with an agent-added human follow-up; useful provenance is not removable residue.
